short_description: A white ceramic coffee mug for grown-ups: our Maker's Seal on one side, 'Talk, touch and play come first' on the other. 11 or 15 oz.
long_description:
The Play Before Pixels mug is a white ceramic coffee mug for grown-ups, printed when you order. It comes in 11 oz and 15 oz.

One side says "Talk, touch and play come first," with a tomato-red ball as the period. The other side carries our logo: a round maker's seal with a spinning top in the middle. One side always faces out, whichever hand you hold it in.

It is for the grown-up who sits on the floor, builds the tower and waits for the answer. It is a small reminder for the person holding it. It is not a rule for anyone else.

The design is printed by sublimation. The ink goes into the mug's coating, so it won't peel off like a decal. Our print partner rates the mug for the dishwasher and the microwave. The care line on this listing gives their exact words.

Each mug is made to order by our print partner and shipped to you with tracking. Allow a few extra days before it ships. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

This is a mug for adults. It is not a child's cup.

Looking for a gift? It goes well with our book 100 Screen-Free Plays, sold separately.

safety.status: UNVERIFIED: no partner documents on file yet; nothing here is a legal opinion.
safety.food_contact: A food-contact item. Use only the print partner's own white ceramic mug blank that the partner states is lead-safe for food contact (UNVERIFIED). Before listing, get the partner's lead and cadmium leach test report for that blank (US FDA ceramicware limits; California Proposition 65) and keep it in this folder. Never claim 'lead-free', 'non-toxic' or 'food-safe' beyond what that report says. No metallic, glitter, color-changing or enamel-look blanks.
safety.prop_65: California Proposition 65 (UNVERIFIED): businesses with fewer than 10 employees are generally exempt from the warning duty, but the print partner, Etsy or a retailer may still require a warning on California shipments of ceramicware. Ask the partner whether it adds a warning; if one is needed, add it to the listing before any California sale.
safety.care_rating: Repeat the partner's own dishwasher- and microwave-safe rating word for word (UNVERIFIED until the partner is chosen). If the partner rates it hand-wash only, change the bullets, FAQ and listing image 4 before upload.
safety.print_method: Sublimation only (ink bonds into the polymer coating); no decals or UV prints that can peel.
safety.children: Adult item only. Never marketed as a child's cup or with children's imagery; kids' drinkware would be a children's product under CPSIA and stays held (legal/LEGAL-LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md row 9).

It still needs the pre-printing slogan search in ORIGINALITY.md section 4 (USPTO class 21 for mugs as well as class 25, plus Etsy, Amazon and Redbubble) before the first sale.
